title: Lock In for 30 Minutes
short: Spend 30 uninterrupted minutes working on something important.
proof: What you worked on, after the timer.

title: Do Your Most Important Task for 30 Minutes
short: Choose the task that matters most today and work on it for 30 focused minutes.
proof: What you worked on, after the timer.

title: Finish One Thing You've Been Avoiding
short: Choose one useful task you have been putting off and finish it.
proof: The finished result. Cover anything private.

title: Plan Tomorrow's Top 3
short: Write down the three most important things you need to get done tomorrow.
proof: Your written list of three.

title: Work With Your Phone Away for 30 Minutes
short: Put your phone away and work without distractions for 30 minutes.
proof: What you worked on, after the timer.

title: Finish One Unfinished Task
short: Choose one incomplete task and finish it today.
proof: The finished result. Cover anything private.

title: Study One Subject for 30 Minutes
short: Spend 30 focused minutes studying one class or subject.
proof: A photo of your notes or the work in front of you. After the timer.

title: Test Yourself Without Looking at Your Notes
short: Choose a topic and answer questions or write what you know without checking your notes first.
proof: Your answers, written from memory.

title: Complete 10 Practice Problems
short: Complete ten useful practice problems for one of your classes.
proof: Your worked problems.

title: Write Everything You Remember About One Topic
short: Without checking your notes first, write everything you remember about one topic.
proof: What you wrote from memory.

title: Finish One Assignment
short: Complete one assignment you need to get done.
proof: The finished assignment or its submitted screen. Hide your name and any grades.

title: Start an Assignment Before It's Urgent
short: Spend focused time beginning an assignment before the deadline becomes stressful.
proof: What you started, after the timer.

title: Turn Today's Notes Into 10 Questions
short: Create ten questions from something you learned today.
proof: Your ten questions.

title: Test Yourself on Flashcards for 20 Minutes
short: Use flashcards to actively test your memory for 20 minutes.
proof: Your flashcards, after the timer.

title: Explain One Difficult Concept From Memory
short: Write an explanation of one difficult concept without checking your notes first.
proof: Your explanation, written from memory.

title: Spend 30 Minutes on Your Hardest Class
short: Spend 30 focused minutes working on the class that currently needs the most attention.
proof: A photo of your notes or the work in front of you. After the timer.

title: Create Your Study Plan for the Week
short: Plan what subjects, assignments, or exams you need to work on this week.
proof: Your written plan.

title: Work on an Upcoming Project for 30 Minutes
short: Spend 30 focused minutes making progress on a school project that is not due today.
proof: Your project work, after the timer.

title: Review a Topic You Learned Earlier This Week
short: Return to something you learned earlier this week and test yourself on it again.
proof: Your review, after the timer.

title: Complete Your Workout
short: Complete the workout you planned for today.
proof: A photo of where you trained: the gym, your equipment, mat or shoes. Not your body.

title: Walk for 30 Minutes
short: Take a purposeful 30-minute walk.
proof: Where you walked, after the timer. Not your face.

title: Do 20 Minutes of Cardio
short: Complete at least 20 minutes of cardio.
proof: Where you did it, after the timer. Not your body.

title: Complete a 30-Minute At-Home Workout
short: Complete a 30-minute workout using whatever equipment or space you have available.
proof: Your workout space or equipment, after the timer. Not your body.

title: Get Outside and Move for 20 Minutes
short: Spend at least 20 minutes moving outside.
proof: Where you were, after the timer. Not your face.

title: Complete Your Planned Strength Workout
short: Complete the strength workout you planned for today.
proof: A photo of where you trained: the gym, your equipment, mat or shoes. Not your body.

title: Do Your Planned Cardio Today
short: Complete the cardio session you planned for today.
proof: Where you did it, after the timer. Not your body.

title: Track Everything You Spend Today
short: Write down everything you spent money on today.
proof: Your written list of what you spent. Written, never a bank or card screen.

title: Review Your Spending From the Last 7 Days
short: Look over what you spent during the past week and identify where your money went.
proof: Your notes or a summary by category. Written, never a bank or card screen.

title: Make a Spending Plan for This Week
short: Decide how you want to use your money this week before you spend it.
proof: Your written plan. Written, never a bank or card screen.

title: Check One Subscription or Recurring Charge
short: Review one recurring expense and decide whether it is still worth paying for.
proof: A written note of the charge and what you decided. No account screenshots.

title: Set One Savings Goal and Deadline
short: Choose something you want to save for, decide how much you need, and give yourself a deadline.
proof: Your written goal, amount and deadline.

title: Improve One Resume Bullet
short: Rewrite one resume bullet so it explains your work, result, or impact more clearly.
proof: The rewritten bullet. Hide anything personal.

title: Apply to One Job or Internship
short: Submit one application for a job, internship, scholarship, or relevant opportunity.
proof: The submitted screen or confirmation. Hide anything personal.

title: Find 3 Opportunities Worth Applying To
short: Find three jobs, internships, scholarships, or opportunities that genuinely fit your goals.
proof: Your list of three.

title: Improve One Part of Your Portfolio
short: Improve one project, page, description, design, or example of your work.
proof: The improved part. Hide anything personal.

title: Practice 5 Interview Questions
short: Practice answering five common or role-specific interview questions.
proof: Your notes on the five answers.

title: Spend 30 Minutes Building a Career Skill
short: Spend 30 focused minutes practicing a skill that can improve your future career opportunities.
proof: What you practiced, after the timer.

title: Add One Project or Accomplishment to Your Resume or Portfolio
short: Document one useful project, achievement, or piece of experience.
proof: The new entry. Hide anything personal.

title: Research 3 Skills Required for a Job You Want
short: Choose a role you're interested in and identify three skills employers commonly expect.
proof: Your notes on the three skills.

title: Practice Explaining One Project You've Built
short: Prepare a clear explanation of what you built, what you did, and what the result was.
proof: Your outline or notes.

title: Complete One Part of an Application
short: Make meaningful progress on a job, internship, scholarship, school, or program application.
proof: The part you finished. Hide anything personal.

title: Work on Your Project for 30 Minutes
short: Spend 30 focused minutes working on something you are building.
proof: What you worked on, after the timer.

title: Finish One Small Part of Your Project
short: Choose one clearly defined piece of your project and finish it.
proof: The finished part.

title: Create One Piece of Content
short: Create one complete piece of useful content for your project, business, portfolio, or audience.
proof: The finished piece.

title: Improve One Page, Screen, Product, or Listing
short: Take one existing part of your project and noticeably improve it.
proof: Before and after.

title: Fix One Problem With Your Project
short: Identify one real problem, bug, weak point, or unfinished issue and fix it.
proof: The fixed result.

title: Write Your Next 3 Project Actions
short: Decide the next three concrete actions required to move your project forward.
proof: Your written list of three.

title: Create One New Design, Prototype, or Draft
short: Turn an idea into something tangible that you can review or improve.
proof: What you made.

title: Review One Important Metric and Make One Decision From It
short: Look at one useful project or business metric and decide what you should do next because of it.
proof: Your written decision. No customer or financial details.

title: Publish Something You Made
short: Finish and publish something useful instead of leaving it unfinished.
proof: What you published.

title: Improve Something You Made Yesterday
short: Return to recent work and make one meaningful improvement.
proof: Before and after.

title: Turn One Idea Into a First Draft
short: Choose one idea and create the first usable version of it.
proof: Your first draft.

title: Practice Your Skill for 30 Minutes
short: Spend 30 focused minutes actively practicing a skill you want to improve.
proof: What you practiced, after the timer.

title: Complete One Lesson, Then Use What You Learned
short: Complete one useful lesson and immediately apply at least one thing from it.
proof: What you made with what you learned.

title: Practice One Weak Part of Your Skill for 20 Minutes
short: Identify the part of your skill you struggle with most and deliberately practice it.
proof: What you practiced, after the timer.

title: Build a Small Project Using Your Skill
short: Create something small that forces you to use the skill you're learning.
proof: What you built.

title: Explain One Thing You Learned From Memory
short: Without checking your source first, explain one thing you recently learned.
proof: Your explanation, written from memory.

title: Create Something You Can Put in a Portfolio
short: Create a finished piece of work that represents your ability.
proof: The finished piece.

title: Improve Something You Created Before
short: Take an older piece of work and make it noticeably better.
proof: Before and after.

title: Watch One Tutorial and Apply One Thing From It
short: Use a tutorial to learn something, then immediately apply that knowledge yourself.
proof: What you made with it.

title: Recreate Something Without Following the Tutorial
short: Try to recreate something you've learned without following the instructions step by step.
proof: What you recreated.

title: Clear Your Desk
short: Remove clutter and reset your workspace.
proof: Before and after of the desk.

title: Do a 15-Minute Room Reset
short: Spend 15 focused minutes cleaning and organizing your space.
proof: Before and after of the room.

title: Pack Everything You Need for Tomorrow
short: Prepare your bag, materials, equipment, or essentials for tomorrow.
proof: What you packed.

title: Reset Your Workspace for Tomorrow
short: Leave your workspace clean and ready for the next day.
proof: Your workspace, ready.

title: Review Your Calendar for the Next 7 Days
short: Look at the next seven days and write down the important deadlines, commitments, or tasks you need to prepare for.
proof: Your written summary. No calendar screenshot needed.
